english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a visual picture of a person, especially a head-and-shoulders image.

exampleSentences.english: This portrait looks a lot like you.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢幅人像畫得幾似你喎。

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a portrait, likeness, or portraits considered as a group.

exampleSentences.traditional: 展覽入面啲人像各有各似，睇得出畫家觀察入微。
